body.title: A Payment to Settle
body.body: You did well with the mediation at the garage, Alex. Now there's something else I need. A certain sum of money was left behind during the dispute—$2,500 in cash. I want it collected from the garage, quietly. No threats, no trouble. Just take it and leave. I'll handle the rest. You're good at this, and I trust you to be careful.
body.speaker: mara
body.outcome: The payment is collected from the garage without incident, resolving the financial dispute and reducing further tension between the mechanics.

approaches.label: Search the tool storage area discreetly, ensuring no one is watching, and retrieve the cash without confrontation.
Confront one of the mechanics directly and demand the money in a more visible part of the garage.

body.title: Garage Payment Request
body.body: You handled the tool dispute well, Alex. Now I need you to collect a payment for garage services. A customer left a deposit for a repair, and it's time to retrieve it. The money is in a locked box under the counter. I don't want any trouble, just get it done quietly. You'll be paid in full for this job.
body.speaker: mara
body.outcome: The agreed payment was collected and reported back without incident.

approaches.label: Retrieve the box without drawing attention
Demand the box be handed over directly
